text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One day during the preparations for the 
Holy Hoof Festival, someone came up and 
asked me if I knew where Air Shakur was."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The preparations are at their peak and 
things are really heating up! Since we're 
doing this, we gotta make sure they get a 
taste of the real thrill too!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If you happen to see them, could you tell 
them to head back to class?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she had said "if you happen to see 
her," I couldn't help feeling concerned, 
and as I searched around the academy—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list:
Someone from your class was looking for 
you, though—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh, really.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After saying that, Air Shakur didn't 
budge. When I asked if she wasn't heading 
back to class—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"You're gonna ask to 'prep for the Holy 
Hoof Festival together' or somethin', 
right? —Don't need it."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's more efficient doing it alone, that's 
why I'm doing it. Leave me be.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I knew she preferred doing things alone, 
but with it being a school event, seeing 
her wandering off so far felt concerning.
choice_data_list:
Wouldn't doing it together help build team 
unity?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Solidarity, huh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
As long as everyone pulls their own 
weight, it's fine. There's no reason to go 
out of your way asking for more.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't care. More importantly, if you stay 
in such a conspicuous spot—

Found you! Located the crew member who 
missed the boat.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, your post is waiting for your 
return! It's a fun voyage after all, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Look at that. Some real pain in the 
neck spotted us.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Aw, don't say that! It's a special 
occasion, and I wanna have fun dancing 
with you too!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The crew's all waiting too, ya know? 
Anchors aweigh! —Just like that!
choice_data_list: You're counting on me, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. He's what you might call the 
first mate on this voyage!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
After all, from the very beginning of the 
preparations――

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
“—What I just sent is a chart laying out 
our classmates' feedback, feasibility, and 
projected turnout.”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Also, I built a quick app to handle our 
shifts during the prep period. Tell 
everyone to enter their schedules ahead of 
time if they have plans.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're seriously the best! You've 
really thought of everything, haven't 
you?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
“—And well, it was done with such 
exquisite skill! Both I and the entire 
crew are truly grateful.”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...You just chimed in for the sake of 
efficiency, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Is playing the villain just in your 
nature? Well, I rather like that about 
you, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …………Annoying.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Either way, far from being isolated, Air 
Shakur seemed to be well relied upon by 
his classmates.
choice_data_list:
Looks like it's gonna be a fun Holy Hoof 
Festival!

Looks like the Holy Hoof Festival is gonna 
be fun, huh!

With Air Shakur leading the way, we'll 
definitely make efficient progress.

With Air Shakur leading the way, we'll 
definitely make efficient progress, won't 
we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Either way, far from being isolated, Air 
Shakur seemed to be well relied upon by 
his classmates.
choice_data_list:
Looks like it's gonna be a fun Holy Hoof 
Festival!

be fun, huh!

With Air Shakur leading the way, we'll 
definitely make efficient progress.

With Air Shakur leading the way, we'll 
definitely make efficient progress, won't 
we?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If you're free on the day, you should come 
watch. Burn our grand moment into your 
eyes!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So with that... let's go, Shakur——Full 
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...So I don't even get a say, huh... Good 
grief.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur reluctantly heads to the 
classroom. However, she was later informed 
that the Holy Hoof Festival was a huge 
success thanks to the efforts of the whole 
class.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"If that's what you think, leave me alone 
for now. Once I'm done with what I gotta 
do, I'll report back."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If you insist. ...Well, I'm counting on 
you then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are many ways to contribute— hearing 
later that the Holy Hoof Festival ended 
without a hitch, that thought crossed my 
mind.
